title: [EPIC] E0 Scope & Architecture Baseline
body:
Outcome: fixed MVP boundaries and implementation architecture for fast execution.

DoD:
- MVP_SCOPE.md committed
- ARCH_DECISIONS.md committed
- Security minimum list fixed
- Core control-loop acceptance criteria approved

title: [EPIC] E1 Platform Bootstrap & Domain Model
body:
Outcome: runnable local platform with DB schema and seeds.

DoD:
- Monorepo bootstrapped
- Docker stack runs locally
- Prisma migrations applied
- Seed data creates demo trainer/student/program

title: [EPIC] E2 Auth + Invite + Membership
body:
Outcome: secure onboarding for trainer and student via invite links.

DoD:
- Trainer signup/login works
- Invite create/revoke works
- Student join via invite works
- Membership/audit events stored
- Role/object checks implemented

title: [EPIC] E3 Programs + Assignments
body:
Outcome: trainer can build and assign programs from exercise library.

DoD:
- Exercise library available
- Program/workout/exercises constructor works
- Assignment flow works
- One active assignment per student enforced

title: [EPIC] E4 Reports + Media + Offline Draft
body:
Outcome: student can submit reliable report with photo even under unstable network.

DoD:
- Report submit is idempotent
- Per-exercise execution facts stored
- Wellbeing and comments stored
- Photo upload to private storage works
- Offline draft + retry works

title: [EPIC] E5 Triggers + Attention Queue + Program Evaluation
body:
Outcome: trainer sees explainable active risks and assignment quality signals.

DoD:
- 3 triggers active (no_report_7d, two_skipped_in_row, wellbeing_low_n_times)
- Explainability payload available
- Attention queue supports resolve with note
- Program evaluation shows adherence and plan-vs-actual trend

title: [EPIC] E6 Notifications + Security Hardening + Release
body:
Outcome: MVP is safely operable in production-like environment.

DoD:
- In-app notifications for trigger activation
- Rate limiting on auth/invite/upload/report submit
- Audit trail complete for critical events
- Backup/restore runbook documented
- Release checklist passed

title: [TASK] Create MVP_SCOPE.md with in/out boundaries
body: Document exact scope for MVP v1 and non-goals to avoid scope creep.

title: [TASK] Create ARCH_DECISIONS.md for variant #1 stack
body: Record architecture decisions: Next.js, NestJS, Postgres, Redis, MinIO, BullMQ, modular monolith.

title: [TASK] Bootstrap monorepo folders and package tooling
body: Create apps/web, apps/api, apps/worker, packages/shared-types, infra/docker.

title: [TASK] Add docker-compose for postgres, redis, minio
body: Provide local stack and healthchecks for all infrastructure components.

title: [TASK] Implement Prisma schema and initial migration set
body: Add entities for trainer/student/group/invite/program/assignment/report/attachment/trigger/notification/audit/domain_event.

title: [TASK] Implement seed script for demo trainer/student/program
body: Seed deterministic demo data for manual QA and e2e smoke.

title: [TASK] Trainer auth endpoints with Argon2id
body: Implement signup/login/logout/refresh flow and secure password handling.

title: [TASK] Session strategy with refresh rotation in httpOnly cookies
body: Implement access+refresh token/session lifecycle and revoke support.

title: [TASK] Role checks and object-level access guards
body: Ensure student sees only own data and trainer sees only own group data.

title: [TASK] Invite model with token hash, TTL, one-time use, revoke
body: Build secure invite lifecycle with token hashing and anti-replay protections.

title: [TASK] Student join flow via invite link
body: Implement invite validation, student account creation, group membership creation.

title: [TASK] Audit log for invite and membership actions
body: Persist audit events for invite_created/used/revoked and membership_created.

title: [TASK] Exercise library seed (curated MVP dataset)
body: Add curated exercise list with stable IDs and basic metadata.

title: [TASK] Trainer program builder API
body: Create/edit program with workouts and workout exercises (no set-level logging).

title: [TASK] Assignment API with one active assignment rule
body: Assign program to student and enforce one active assignment per student.

title: [TASK] Student current workout read API
body: Expose current assignment/workout details for mobile student flow.

title: [TASK] Report draft and submit API with idempotency key
body: Persist report, exercise executions, wellbeing and comments; prevent duplicate submit.

title: [TASK] Student report UI flow (today -> workout -> submit)
body: Implement mobile-first report flow including done/skipped/modified and plan-vs-actual inputs.

title: [TASK] Private media upload API backed by MinIO
body: Support report photo uploads with size/type/count limits and metadata storage.

title: [TASK] Signed URL media read with ACL checks
body: Only authorized trainer/student can access attachment through short-lived signed URLs.

title: [TASK] Offline draft storage and retry queue in web app
body: Store report draft in IndexedDB and auto-retry submit on connectivity restoration.

title: [TASK] Trigger engine v1 worker pipeline
body: Implement event + scheduled reconcile trigger evaluation with BullMQ.

title: [TASK] Implement trigger rule no_report_7d
body: Activate trigger when no report has been submitted for more than 7 days.

title: [TASK] Implement trigger rule two_skipped_in_row
body: Activate trigger when two consecutive workouts are skipped.

title: [TASK] Implement trigger rule wellbeing_low_n_times
body: Activate trigger when poor wellbeing repeats above threshold in time window.

title: [TASK] Add explainability payload for every trigger activation
body: Store why/when/data points for trigger activation and resolution decisions.

title: [TASK] Attention queue API and trainer UI
body: Show active triggers sorted by urgency with reason chips and timestamps.

title: [TASK] Trigger resolution workflow with trainer note
body: Allow trainer to mark trigger resolved and persist action note and actor.

title: [TASK] Program evaluation service (adherence + plan-vs-actual trend)
body: Compute basic assignment quality metrics and expose to trainer view.

title: [TASK] In-app notifications for trigger activation
body: Create notification records when high-priority trigger becomes active.

title: [TASK] Rate limiting for auth/invite/upload/report endpoints
body: Apply endpoint throttling to reduce abuse and brute-force attempts.

title: [TASK] Add domain_event table and emit key events
body: Emit ReportSubmitted, TriggerActivated, TriggerResolved for future integrations.

title: [TASK] Build e2e smoke tests for control loop
body: Cover trainer invite -> student join -> report submit -> trigger activation -> resolution.

title: [TASK] Prepare runbook: local run, backup/restore, release checklist
body: Document operational basics for self-hosted deployment and recovery.

title: [TASK] Add alpha checkpoint API smoke doc
body: Document a reproducible API-only smoke scenario for auth + invites + student join before frontend implementation.

title: [TASK] Fix Prisma opposite relation for Exercise and WorkoutExercise
body: Add missing opposite relation field on Exercise model to satisfy Prisma schema validation.

title: [TASK] Implement private media uploads via filesystem provider
body: Replace MinIO dependency for MVP media path with local filesystem storage provider, private access checks, and report attachment endpoints.
